en.summary: The patch fixes an L2 MSHR scheduling bug by suppressing schedule.d.valid while an A-channel request from the same MSHR is still pending.
why_it_counts: MSHR.scala changes io.schedule.d.valid to also require sche_a_valid to be false.
sche_a_valid tracks whether this MSHR still has an outstanding schedule.a request.
Without this gate, the MSHR can advertise D-side work too early and be accepted in the wrong order.
evidence: sche_a_valid is set on allocate and cleared only when io.schedule.a.fire.
io.schedule.d.valid already depended on io.valid and sink_d_reg, and now also blocks on sche_a_valid.

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: MSHR schedule.d valid gating against outstanding schedule.a
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: Change io.schedule.d.valid back to io.valid and sink_d_reg, removing the extra gate on sche_a_valid.
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The scheduler accepts D-side work before the miss request for the same MSHR has launched, creating premature acceptance or ordering errors.
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: An MSHR entry that still owes an outbound miss request should not simultaneously advertise downstream completion-side work as ready. If D-side scheduling becomes visible too early, the scheduler can accept work before the miss request has actually launched.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: MSHR A-side versus D-side schedule ordering
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An MSHR has return-path data or status while its outbound request side is still pending.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Allow D-side schedule valid to ignore the flag that an A-side request is still outstanding.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop pending-request exclusion from ready/valid predicate
portability_notes: The reusable bug is premature visibility of a later transaction stage while an earlier stage is still pending.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the predicate that marks an MSHR eligible for D/refill/response-side scheduling.
Remove the term that suppresses eligibility while a request-side launch is still pending.
Stress with delayed request-side issuance and observe early acceptance.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds !sche_a_valid to io.schedule.d.valid so D-side scheduling stays hidden until the A-side schedule request has fired.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: At the io.schedule.d.valid assignment near the top of MSHR.scala, remove the !sche_a_valid term.

evidence_for_injection: sche_a_valid also drives io.schedule.a.valid in the surrounding code.
The fix is a one-line schedule-visibility gate, so reinjection is precise.

zh.summary: 该补丁修复了 L2 MSHR 调度错误：当同一个 MSHR 的 A 通道请求仍未完成时，不再提前拉高 schedule.d.valid。
why_it_counts: MSHR.scala 把 io.schedule.d.valid 修改为额外要求 sche_a_valid 为假。
sche_a_valid 用于跟踪该 MSHR 是否仍有未完成的 schedule.a 请求。
没有这个门控时，MSHR 可能过早暴露 D 侧工作，从而以错误顺序被接受。
evidence: sche_a_valid 在 allocate 时置位，只在 io.schedule.a.fire 时清零。
io.schedule.d.valid 原本依赖 io.valid 和 sink_d_reg，现在还会受 sche_a_valid 阻塞。

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: MSHR 中 schedule.d 相对 outstanding schedule.a 的 valid 门控
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: 把 io.schedule.d.valid 改回仅依赖 io.valid 和 sink_d_reg，去掉对 sche_a_valid 的额外门控。
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 调度器会在同一 MSHR 的 miss 请求真正发出前就接受 D 侧工作，产生过早接受或次序错误。
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 如果某个 MSHR 条目仍然欠着一个对外 miss 请求，它就不应该同时把完成侧工作对调度器暴露为 ready。如果 D 侧调度过早变得可见，调度器就可能在 miss 请求真正发出前先接受后续阶段工作。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: MSHR 中 A 侧与 D 侧的调度次序
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个 MSHR 已经带有返回路径数据或状态，但其对外请求侧仍处于 pending。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 D 侧 schedule valid 忽略“同一条目仍有 A 侧请求未发出”的标志。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 从 ready/valid 谓词中删除 pending-request 排斥项
portability_notes: 可复用的错误本质是：更早事务阶段尚未完成时，就过早暴露更晚阶段工作。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把某个 MSHR 标记为可进行 D/refill/response-side 调度的谓词。
删除其中“request-side 仍 pending 时禁止可用”的条件。
在 request-side 发射被延迟时观察是否出现过早接受。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: 针对 sche_a_valid 的 io.schedule.d.valid 限定
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复在 io.schedule.d.valid 中加入 !sche_a_valid，使 D 侧调度在 A-side schedule 请求真正 fire 前保持不可见。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 MSHR.scala 顶部附近的 io.schedule.d.valid 赋值处，去掉 !sche_a_valid。

evidence_for_injection: 周边代码里 sche_a_valid 也驱动 io.schedule.a.valid。
修复只是单行的调度可见性门控，因此 reinjection 很精确。
